note: MockMob's public corrections log, drawn at /corrections (src/app/corrections/page.js) newest first, and read through data/corrections.mjs.
Add an entry only once the change is live on production: an answer key corrected, a question reworded or moved, a question taken out of practice, or one held back for a re-check.

date: the day in IST the change took effect, YYYY-MM-DD, never a day still to come. subject: one subject's name, 'All subjects', or 'N subjects' with bySubject (each subject's count, adding up to count).
count: how many questions changed (leave it out only when the change touched every question). action: fixed, pulled or held. found: check (our own check) or report (a student's report).
wrong and did: one plain sentence each, ending with a full stop, that a 16 year old understands. Never write the answer of a question students still see, and no exclamation marks.
source: the commit, migration or file that proves the entry. It is never shown on the page, and an entry without one fails the test.
id: a unique slug, the date then a few words. The test (data/tests/corrections.test.mjs) fails on any entry that breaks these rules.
